system.description:
You may use this skill if your sub class is Painter, Novelist, Counterfeiter, or Connoisseur. One item of your choice from your inventory acquires the [Extra Value n] tag. Make one roll on [Treasure Table: Money]; the rating of [Extra Value n] is equal to the amount of money rolled. When selling the item, increase the selling price of that item by the rating.

A feat that adds your own ingenuity to an item, adding value as a work of art.
